scope: Proposed research-to-implementation work packages; no runtime changes implemented by this upload

tasks.title: Signal metadata, quality and deterministic replay contract
acceptance: Preserve optional component channels and NaN backfill
Test timestamp/unit/validity round trips and missing or stale messages
Keep measured, estimated and simulated channels distinguishable

tasks.title: Feasible actuator envelope for the transient four-wheel model
acceptance: Report requested, limited and achieved torque with active constraints
Test motor/wheel ratio and power signs without double-counted inertia
Retain unconstrained cases only as labeled references

tasks.title: Multi-channel prediction and measurement correlation
acceptance: Preserve pre-test predictions and independent holdouts
Separate alignment, numerical and parameter uncertainty
Do not pass validation solely on lap time

tasks.title: Fixed-clock software-in-the-loop controller adapter
acceptance: Controller rate is independent of spatial cells and UI/logging frequency
Test deterministic schedules, plant substeps and latency separately
Inject sensor and communications faults; keep network services outside control

tasks.title: Tyre and load model identification with validity envelopes
acceptance: Test combined slip, low loads and extrapolation status
Preserve opt-in model selection until force scale is validated
Keep restricted tyre measurements out of public fixtures

tasks.title: Regeneration and mechanical brake coordination
acceptance: Respect battery charge acceptance and actual actuator topology
Account separately for regeneration, friction braking and unmet demand
Test transitions, low speed and loss of regeneration with consistent energy signs

tasks.title: Energy and thermal scenario studies
acceptance: Compare equal-energy pace and equal-pace energy scenarios
Report initial SOC, ambient and thermal assumptions
Prevent optimization from exploiting negative losses or unsupported maps

tasks.title: Aero and road geometry provenance and validity
acceptance: Track graphics/physics transformations and source geometry
Preserve wind/ground-velocity and aero-work conventions
Propagate invalid map/road queries into comparison status

tasks.title: Isolated STM32 and CAN hardware-in-the-loop bench
acceptance: Use reviewed real interface definitions and measure latency/jitter
Repeat SIL fault scenarios and record deadline misses
Require team safety review before energized vehicle integration

tasks.title: Driver and experiment interface without duplicated physics
acceptance: Keep presentation rate independent of plant and controller rates
Synchronize inputs, alarms, commands, results and debrief markers
Separate driver preference from objective performance claims
